verifications.claim: As of mid-March 2026, SpaceX has completed over 30 launches early in the year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "From both Florida and California launches combined, it marks the 32nd launch of the year for SpaceX alone." (March 14, 2026)
verifications.reasoning: Directly states 32 launches by March 14, supporting 'over 30' as of mid-March.

verifications.claim: As of mid-March 2026, SpaceX maintains weekly Falcon 9 Starlink missions from Florida and California.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: Starlink 17-31 from Vandenberg (CA) March 13; R2: Starlink from Cape Canaveral (FL) March 14; R6: Multiple Starlink missions listed in March from SLC-40 FL and SLC-4E CA (e.g., March 13 CA, 14 FL, 16 CA, 17 FL).
verifications.reasoning: Frequent Starlink missions from both locations shown, implying weekly cadence, but not explicitly stated as 'weekly' plan.

verifications.claim: A Starlink Mission using Falcon 9 is scheduled from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 16, 2026.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions a Starlink mission from Cape Canaveral (FL/SLC-40) on March 16; R6 lists March 16 Starlink from SLC-4E (CA).

verifications.claim: A Starlink Mission using Falcon 9 is scheduled from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 18, 2026.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions Starlink from Cape Canaveral on March 18.

verifications.claim: Artemis II Crewed Lunar Mission using Falcon Heavy (NASA) is scheduled for April 2026 (NET April 6).
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft'; R5: 'Orion spacecraft'; R7: 'SLS Block 1 | Artemis II'; R9: 'SLS Block 1 | Artemis II'. NET April 1-6 window confirmed.
verifications.reasoning: Artemis II uses SLS/Orion, not Falcon Heavy; date supported but rocket contradicted.

verifications.claim: ViaSat-3 F3 using Falcon Heavy is scheduled from Kennedy Space Center in April 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: 'ViaSat-3 ... NET April' (under SpaceX schedule, GTO); R7: 'ViaSat-3 ... NET April' (Kennedy Space Center).
verifications.reasoning: ViaSat-3 NET April from KSC supported; Falcon Heavy implied for GTO on SpaceX but not explicitly stated; 'F3' not specified.

verifications.claim: MRV-1 Mission is scheduled from Cape Canaveral in May 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: 'SpaceLogistics MRV-1 ... NET Q2' (GTO, under SpaceX).
verifications.reasoning: NET Q2 (includes May) supported; Cape Canaveral plausible for SpaceX GTO but location and exact month not specified.

verifications.claim: SDA Tranche 1 Tracking Layer is scheduled from Vandenberg SFB in June 2026.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Tranche 1 Tracking Layer mentioned NET 2026 or Q2 but no June date or Vandenberg location specified.

verifications.claim: Griffin Mission One using Falcon Heavy is scheduled from Kennedy Space Center in July 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R7: 'Demonstration flight of the Astrobotic Griffin lander ... NET July 2026' (Kennedy Space Center).
verifications.reasoning: Griffin lander NET July KSC supported; Falcon Heavy not specified.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'marking humanity’s return to deep space for the first time in more than 50 years ... breaking an over 50 year record'; R3: first piloted SLS/Orion to Moon.
verifications.reasoning: Directly described as first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II uses a SpaceX Falcon Heavy for training and validation.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft'; no mention of Falcon Heavy; SpaceX lander for later missions.
verifications.reasoning: Artemis II uses NASA SLS/Orion, not SpaceX Falcon Heavy.

verifications.claim: Artemis II has a critical window in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'must launch Artemis 2 by April 6 or ... slip ... For an April 1 launch'; R5: 'window from April 1st to April 6th'.
verifications.reasoning: Explicit April window confirmed as critical due to lunar trajectory constraints.

verifications.claim: SpaceX plans weekly Starlink launches throughout 2026 to build the Gen2 constellation.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: Multiple Starlink missions (V2 Mini); R4/R6: Numerous Starlink batches scheduled (e.g., Group 17-17, ongoing batches).
verifications.reasoning: Frequent Starlink launches shown, but no explicit 'weekly throughout 2026' plan or 'Gen2' label.

verifications.evidence: "Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope ... Last Update: NET September 28."
